description: Angular component for uploading images, including handling of SCADA symbols, with form validation, file processing, and integration with image service.

classes.name: UploadImageDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular dialog component for uploading images and SCADA symbols, with form validation and file processing.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form and sets up value change subscriptions for file input, especially for SCADA symbols.

methods.name: imageFileNameChanged
methods.description: Updates the title control when the image file name changes.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if the form control is in an error state for validation display.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without returning data.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles the upload process, including metadata updates for SCADA symbols, and calls to image service.
